in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left","dimensions":{"length_in":24.3,"max_width_in":23.63,"nametag_slot_in":[3.375,0.75],"sleeve_widening":{"outward_in":2.6,"method":"the sleeve run of the outline only (epaulet end S to armpit corner A) is widened: the outer edge shifts sideways by a share that rises from 0 at S to the full outward_in over the first 25 % of its length (smoothstep, the shoulder cap) and stays there to the cuff, the cuff moves rigidly by outward_in, the underside share falls linearly to 0 at A (it stays one straight line); S, A, the shoulder, epaulet, collar, armhole seam, side seam, waist, hips and hem do not move","size_source":"estimated","note":"outward widening of the traced long sleeve so the regulation 3 1/2 in chevron (5.7 in tall) lies between the outline and the armhole seam; the regulation gives no sleeve width (CAPR 39-1 4.2.6.2.3). Chosen as the smallest step of 0.1 in that leaves the ink of every senior NCO chevron (SSgt to CMSgt) at least 0.1 in clear of the seam. The traced long sleeve is only about 1.9 in wide between its outer edge and the armhole seam at the chevron line (the short sleeve is 5.4 in at the cuff), hence the larger amount; the chevron is centred halfway between the shoulder seam and the elbow (the elbow at 55 % of the way to the cuff is an anatomical estimate, as on the aviator and Class A sheets). The bodice is as traced (21.0 in scale applies to the unwidened sleeve-to-sleeve span; sleeve-to-sleeve is now 21.0 + 2 x outward_in).","visible_sleeve_axis_in":9.93}},"documented":["white semi-form-fitting princess-line overblouse with two epaulets, long or short sleeves; long sleeves end 1/4 to 1/2 in below the wrist, rounded cuffs with buttonhole closures (CAPR 39-1 4.2.6.1.2)","nametag centred on the right side even with or up to 1 1/2 in higher or lower than the first exposed button, parallel to the ground (4.2.6.2.6.1.2)","ribbons centred on the left between the buttons and the arm seam, even with to 1 1/2 in above or below the first exposed button; bottom row even with the bottom of the nameplate (4.2.6.2.6.2.2)","blue inverted-V tie tab (4.2.6.3 / 4.2.4.3)"],"assumed":["21.0 in scale","nametag / ribbon slot sizes","gray skirt as drawn in the figure (slacks are a bottoms variant)","epaulet strap shape (plain; the figure draws gray officer sleeves)","sleeve widening of the long sleeve (see dimensions.sleeve_widening)","elbow at 55 % of the way from the shoulder seam to the cuff"],"fit":{"method":"traced from a Vanguard product photo","score":null},"grade":"garment"}
